name: last30days-skill
description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
one_liner: An AI research assistant that scans Reddit, X, YouTube, Hacker News, and prediction markets to tell you what's genuinely trending on any topic right now, with sources to back it up.
buyer: A content creator, marketer, or trend-focused newsletter writer who needs a fast, credible read on what's hot before writing about it.
business_use_cases: A social-media agency runs it every morning to pick which trending topics to build client content around that day.
A niche newsletter writer uses it to find what their audience is already talking about before drafting the week's issue.
A startup's marketing team uses it to spot an emerging conversation early and jump in before competitors notice.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a daily 'what's trending in your niche' briefing to small businesses and creators as a subscription product.
Offer one-off trend research reports to marketing teams prepping a campaign.

steal_this: Run it daily for one niche (fitness, personal finance, AI tools) and sell the resulting trend digest to five creators in that niche for $29/month each.
